videos.title: Load balancing explained
videos.summary: How traffic reaches healthy application servers
videos.narration: A load balancer distributes requests among healthy application instances. Health checks remove failed instances from rotation.

videos.title: RAG in one minute
videos.summary: How retrieval helps language models use external knowledge
videos.narration: Retrieval augmented generation searches a knowledge base for relevant passages and provides them to a language model as context. Answers still require evaluation.

videos.title: An API request's journey
videos.summary: Follow a browser request through a backend
videos.narration: The browser sends an HTTPS request. The backend validates inputs, checks permissions, queries storage, and returns a structured response.

videos.title: Start a system design interview
videos.summary: Clarify, estimate, and reason about tradeoffs
videos.narration: Before drawing an architecture, clarify scale, traffic, latency, reliability, and constraints. Then explain why your design fits those requirements.

videos.title: Cache-aside pattern
videos.summary: Why Redis can reduce database load
videos.narration: With cache-aside, the application checks Redis first. On a miss, it loads from the database and populates the cache. Plan for expiration and invalidation.

quiz.q: What is a common cache problem?

videos.title: Safe AI tool calling
videos.narration: A model may propose a tool call, but the application must validate arguments, enforce permissions, handle timeouts, and audit results.

videos.title: Database indexes
videos.summary: How B-tree indexes speed up reads
videos.narration: Indexes help locate matching records without scanning every row. They also consume storage and slow some writes. Inspect query plans before optimizing.

videos.title: Debugging under pressure
videos.narration: Start by reproducing the failure and checking telemetry. Narrow the failing component, test a hypothesis, then add regression coverage.
